bounds.required_kind: Existing whole production source-browser path, including actual native UI/source/restart checks and the cold native preference fixture.

visualSettings.camera_settings: Exact per-case controls in the approved source pack; no reduced draw distance/resolution for performance.

sourceChecks: actual headful Chrome namespace/seccomp sandbox
real compiled source UI title, nonblank pixels and logical viewport
actual logical UI/backing-pixel separation at approved minimum/maximum/primary resize sizes
actual source title controls bind to the real audio graph, unlock on gesture and mute without resetting source positions
actual UI registration through binary WASM/account RPC
real UI wrong-password rejection with server error ID and no world
real UI login without seeded character/world
complete native preview request retains unavailable base/equipment; no dummy loadout or preview substitution
empty source creation, real join and separate sequenced appearance confirmation from UI
complete UI amount/recovery capabilities, actual scene and source-owned music/partial-varp authority arrive through generated WASM
actual UI source brand-new experience selection advances only through the authoritative request
actual source public-chat permission remains locked; no unlock or message is fabricated
real source unlocks, native UI preferences and actor-scoped storage bind to the exact applied world; missing spatial scene and physical output remain separate gates
real streamed source blocks at the authoritative region; nonblank hardware WebGPU with an explicitly recorded camera
per-world-frame performance.now receipts remain contiguous under the actual two-frame pipeline; metrics are engineering-only
actual same-artifact server restart/reconnect preserves acknowledged appearance/progress/possessions
actual UI logout/relogin resumes the same source character without repeating creation
actual component asset routes have no failed responses or unhandled page errors
GPU-completed frame records use actual canvas submission/receipt observations and correct performance.now clock
actual game-device-loss fault check stops GPU frame publication and displays a terminal UI error; no fallback
separate native audio/storage contract fixture after GPU teardown verifies load/apply/save/entry fences; fixture world/unlocks/UI port are NOT game-journey or simultaneous-workload evidence
nativeStorageContracts: genuine browser storage completes before the real native world/apply/projection boundary
trusted handler starts real WebAudio resume and verified original source62 playback
actual native fallback/remembered mute, nonlinear mixers and exact saved-slot holes persist without authority
Single Skip uses the actual typed disabled_mode command, never a mode flip
genuine title clears native binding; same-actor re-entry reloads storage and fences prior controls
delayed real browser writes are serialized/coalesced per actor; the older save cannot overwrite33
runs.pcmQualification: Actual post-gain output compared to the actual submitted decoded buffer; not an independent original-server timing or physical-speaker capture.
runs.cleanup: Existing fixture asserted closed context, zero voices/queue/cache/pending, disposed control input and removed fixture storage; isolated wrapper cleaned owned server/PostgreSQL/Xvfb/Chrome/profile/scratch.
